label: Pipeline response
calculation: For each of 8 matched scenario pairs: (order at low outstanding quantity − order at high outstanding quantity) / (high − low outstanding quantity). Average the 8 slopes equally.

label: Total holding + backlog cost
calculation: Sum (0.5 × end-of-week inventory + 1 × end-of-week backlog) across 4 roles and 24 weeks.

label: Weekly order variance
calculation: For each role, sum the squared deviations of its 24 orders from its own mean, divide by 23, then average the 4 role variances.

label: Bullwhip ratio
calculation: Within each chain, divide each role's 24-week sample order variance by the 24-week sample variance of final-consumer demand; average the 4 ratios. Then average chains. Do not divide pooled condition means.

label: Inventory-holding cost
calculation: Sum 0.5 × inventory across 4 roles and 24 weeks, per chain.

label: Backlog cost
calculation: Sum 1 × unfilled demand across 4 roles and 24 weeks, per chain.

label: New replenishment order
calculation: Literal integer order chosen by the model for a role in a week.
aggregation: Mean across 960 role-week observations per condition

label: Incoming demand at a role
calculation: Customer demand at retailer; downstream orders arriving at each upstream role.
aggregation: Mean across 960 role-week observations per condition

label: Replenishment received
calculation: Cases delivered to this role at the start of the current week.
aggregation: Mean across 960 role-week observations per condition

label: Cases shipped to downstream customer
calculation: Cases sent to satisfy current or previously unfilled demand during the week.
aggregation: Mean across 960 role-week observations per condition

label: End-of-week physical inventory
calculation: Stock remaining after receipts and shipments, before the new order.
aggregation: Mean across 960 role-week observations per condition

label: End-of-week unfilled demand
calculation: Demand still waiting to be supplied after current shipments.
aggregation: Mean across 960 role-week observations per condition

label: Net inventory
calculation: Physical inventory minus backlog, for the same role and week.
aggregation: Mean across 960 role-week observations per condition

label: Outstanding replenishment before new order
calculation: Previously ordered cases not yet received; does not include this week's new order.
aggregation: Mean across 960 role-week observations per condition

label: Outstanding replenishment after new order
calculation: Outstanding before order + current week's new order.
aggregation: Mean across 960 role-week observations per condition

label: Weekly role cost
calculation: 0.5 × remaining inventory + 1 × backlog in this role/week.
aggregation: Mean across 960 role-week observations per condition

label: Final-consumer demand
calculation: Exogenous customer demand, counted once per chain/week (not four times).

label: Final-consumer demand variance
calculation: Sample variance of the 24 customer-demand values (denominator 23); the denominator used for bullwhip.

label: Smallest observed game order
calculation: Minimum/maximum across all 960 orders in the condition.

label: Largest observed game order
calculation: Minimum/maximum across all 960 orders in the condition.

label: Fraction of game orders equal to zero
calculation: Count zero orders / 96 orders in a chain; average chains. Also equals pooled count / 960 because all chains are complete.

label: Final physical inventory
calculation: Sum this quantity across the 4 roles at week 24; then average chains.

label: Final unfilled demand
calculation: Sum this quantity across the 4 roles at week 24; then average chains.

label: Final outstanding replenishment
calculation: Sum this quantity across the 4 roles at week 24; then average chains.

label: Response to unfilled demand
calculation: Mean of 8 separate matched-pair slopes: (order at high backlog − order at low backlog) / increase in backlog.

label: Fraction of probe answers equal to zero
calculation: Zero probe orders / 32 per chain, averaged across chains.

label: Smallest probe order
calculation: Overall minimum/maximum across 320 probe answers.

label: Largest probe order
calculation: Overall minimum/maximum across 320 probe answers.

label: Chains with all 32 probe answers identical
calculation: Count chains whose 32 observed probe answers all have the same value.

label: Pipeline: Smallest pair response
calculation: Minimum of the 8 pair slopes in each chain; average chain minima.

label: Pipeline: Largest pair response
calculation: Maximum of the 8 pair slopes in each chain; average chain maxima.

label: Pipeline: SD across pair responses
calculation: Sample SD of the 8 pair slopes in each chain (denominator 7); average chain SDs.

label: Pipeline: Fraction of pairs with no response
calculation: Number of exactly zero slopes / 8 pairs in a chain; average chains.

label: Pipeline: Regression response (diagnostic)
calculation: Pair-intercept regression; equivalent to average pair slopes weighted by squared quantity changes. This is NOT the equal-weight primary endpoint.

label: Pipeline: Regression intercept
calculation: Within each pair: mean order − raw common regression slope × mean quantity.
aggregation: Mean across 160 probe observations per condition

label: Pipeline: Regression fitted order
calculation: Pair intercept + raw common regression slope × displayed quantity.
aggregation: Mean across 160 probe observations per condition

label: Pipeline: Regression residual
calculation: Actual probe order − regression fitted order. Mean residual can be zero by construction; inspect individual values.
aggregation: Mean across 160 probe observations per condition

label: Backlog: Smallest pair response
calculation: Minimum of the 8 pair slopes in each chain; average chain minima.

label: Backlog: Largest pair response
calculation: Maximum of the 8 pair slopes in each chain; average chain maxima.

label: Backlog: SD across pair responses
calculation: Sample SD of the 8 pair slopes in each chain (denominator 7); average chain SDs.

label: Backlog: Fraction of pairs with no response
calculation: Number of exactly zero slopes / 8 pairs in a chain; average chains.

label: Backlog: Regression response (diagnostic)
calculation: Pair-intercept regression; equivalent to average pair slopes weighted by squared quantity changes. This is NOT the equal-weight primary endpoint.

label: Backlog: Regression intercept
calculation: Within each pair: mean order − raw common regression slope × mean quantity.
aggregation: Mean across 160 probe observations per condition

label: Backlog: Regression fitted order
calculation: Pair intercept + raw common regression slope × displayed quantity.
aggregation: Mean across 160 probe observations per condition

label: Backlog: Regression residual
calculation: Actual probe order − regression fitted order. Mean residual can be zero by construction; inspect individual values.
aggregation: Mean across 160 probe observations per condition

label: Correct comprehension answers
calculation: Score against the frozen four-item answer key after gameplay and probes.

label: Comprehension accuracy
calculation: Correct answers / answered questions; every case answered all four.

label: Correctly recalled fictional allowance
calculation: Count literal public disclosures matching the assigned 120 or 8 seconds; absence is missing, never imputed.
aggregation: Count of correct observed disclosures; N reports disclosures found

label: Weekly order packet (4 choices): mean of per-context median elapsed times
calculation: Median observed packet latency in each context, then mean across 10 contexts. Includes transport, scheduling and output; not measured thinking time.

label: Weekly order packet (4 choices): mean of per-context 90th percentiles
calculation: Nearest-rank 90th percentile in each context (ceil(0.9 × count)), then mean across contexts. Includes transport, scheduling and output; not measured thinking time.

label: Weekly order packet (4 choices): largest observed elapsed time
calculation: Maximum packet latency across all 10 contexts. Includes transport, scheduling and output; not measured thinking time.

label: Probe packet (4 choices): mean of per-context median elapsed times
calculation: Median observed packet latency in each context, then mean across 10 contexts. Includes transport, scheduling and output; not measured thinking time.

label: Probe packet (4 choices): mean of per-context 90th percentiles
calculation: Nearest-rank 90th percentile in each context (ceil(0.9 × count)), then mean across contexts. Includes transport, scheduling and output; not measured thinking time.

label: Probe packet (4 choices): largest observed elapsed time
calculation: Maximum packet latency across all 10 contexts. Includes transport, scheduling and output; not measured thinking time.

label: Quiz packet (4 answers): mean of per-context median elapsed times
calculation: Median observed packet latency in each context, then mean across 10 contexts. Includes transport, scheduling and output; not measured thinking time.

label: Quiz packet (4 answers): mean of per-context 90th percentiles
calculation: Nearest-rank 90th percentile in each context (ceil(0.9 × count)), then mean across contexts. Includes transport, scheduling and output; not measured thinking time.

label: Quiz packet (4 answers): largest observed elapsed time
calculation: Maximum packet latency across all 10 contexts. Includes transport, scheduling and output; not measured thinking time.

label: Completed game weeks

label: Actual probe answers
calculation: Count literal answers to the 32 fixed hypothetical states.

calculation: Both orders present in each of the 8 planned pipeline pairs.

label: Missing pipeline pairs

label: Complete backlog pairs
